summary: The full IonBase lockup — mark plus wordmark.
useWhen: the product needs to identify itself: header, sign-in page, empty state, marketing surface

useInstead.when: space is tight, or a wordmark already appears nearby
you need any graphic that is not the brand

sm.use: the default — a 24px mark, which is what a header bar wants

lg.use: a 32px mark — sign-in, splash, or anywhere the brand is the subject

vector.use: the default and the safe choice — Figma's serif logotype as frozen artwork, immune to font substitution and visually distinct from the UI type

text.use: live, selectable Host Grotesk at `text/tertiary` — for surfaces where the name should behave like text (copyable, searchable) rather than like a mark

guarantees: the wordmark carries the accessible name, so the mark beside it is not announced twice
artwork uses `currentColor` rather than Figma's baked hex, so it themes with the rest of the icon layer

antiPatterns.dont: recolouring the lockup with your own fill
antiPatterns.why: it inherits `icon/default`; overriding it is how a brand mark ends up failing contrast in one theme

antiPatterns.dont: putting the Logo inside a Link with its own text "IonBase"
antiPatterns.why: the name is announced twice; label the link, not both
